{{Quote|Corellian engineering. A CEC ship will keep going until it hits something.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Corellian Engineering Corporation''', abbreviated '''CEC''' and originally called '''Corellian Engineering Corps''', was one of the three largest [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers. This corporation was widely considered the most prolific starship manufacturer in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
CEC, whose [[CEC shipyards|shipyards]] were located in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], owed much of its success to the abnormally high numbers of skilled designers, engineers, and shipwrights the system produced. The shipyards were well known for their modular freighters which could be upgraded for combat with both legal and illegal after-market kits. These popular freighters ranged from the [[YG-series/Legends|YG-series]] first made centuries before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to the [[VCX series/Legends|VCX series]] produced shortly before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

[[File:CECO01AB1.jpg|thumb|left|Corellian Engineering Corporation advertisement flier for the CR90 Corvette and YT-1300]]
Unlike the company's main competitors ([[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]), CEC relied almost solely on civilian sales rather than military contracts. Even so, CEC's reputation for solid spaceframes and excellent engines meant that it was often subcontracted to build warships using other companies' designs: [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] built by CEC had a reputation for being the fastest ships in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], both at sublight and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] speeds.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] boasted of having outrun such ships. CEC also constructed vessels for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

In the centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] was guarded by warships bigger than [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]]. These were presumably also homemade designs rather than imports from other notable shipwrights, like [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] or [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili Star Drive]].

CEC also teamed up with [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] to jointly fund [[The Nerfworks]], a radical think tank responsible for a number of starship designs, including some droid starships. In addition, it jointly owned [[Chempat Engineered Defenses]] with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. A competing shipwright, [[Corellia StarDrive]], was bought by CEC after their senior design team was killed in a shuttle crash.

==History==
{{Quote|The guilty party is Corellian Engineering Corporation. The oldest ship manufacturer in Republic history.|[[Darth Charnus]]|<ref name="TOR:CW">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Corporate Warfare|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The Corellian Engineering Corporation was one of the oldest starship manufacturers in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] history<ref name="TOR:CW" /> and claimed to be the longest-operating business entity in galactic history.<ref name="TOR:CEC" />

[[File:CEC_Tower.png|thumb|left|250px|The CEC Island during the Battle of Corellia]]
During the [[Galactic War]], CEC supported the Galactic Republic in the war against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] attempted to infiltrate the offices of the Corellian Engineering Corporation in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] in order to take control of the corporation's powerful defense systems. However, the operation was a failure and all Intelligence's operatives were uncovered.<ref name="TOR:CEC" /> When the Sith invasion of Corellia finally started, in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time-3">{{TOR dates|3}}</ref> the company found itself on the frontline of the battle. In the [[Incorporation Islands]], powerful local corporations, particularly the CEC, supported the Corellian forces and attacked Imperial troops. Furthermore, CEC used [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weapons]] to neutralize Coronet's [[rocket tram]]s that were used by the Empire to move its troops. The CEC headquarters soon became the main target of the Sith but Imperial forces were not able to pass through the company's formidable defensive system. [[Darth Charnus]] therefore ordered his special operatives and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Jastal]] of the [[Imperial Guard]] to capture the [[hull-cracker]] experimental weapon from the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="TOR:CW" /> After securing the weapon, Imperial operatives directly attacked the [[CEC Island]] and fought CEC's massive [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]. The operatives were finally able to disable the droids by destroying signal towers.<ref name="TOR:EB">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Engineering Breakdown|Corellia}}</ref> The Empire then used the hull-cracker to breach the CEC headquarters. Imperial troops assaulted the Central Tower and pummeled all resistance, including the powerful [[C-9X]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]]. The Sith forces eventually slaughtered the CEC board of directors and took steps to replace them.<ref name="TOR:IC" /> Although the Sith Empire was eventually drove out of Corellia, resulting in a major Republic victory,<ref name="TOR:TFoC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Fall of Corellia|Vaiken Spacedock}}</ref> the Battle of Corellia was a major disaster for the Corellian Engineering Corporation.<ref name="TOR:IC" />

During the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]], the Corellian Engineering Corporation was rumoured to be developing an experimental stealth technology for a mysterious buyer.<ref name="TOR:OtR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Off the Radar}}</ref>

Some time after the fall of the [[Corellian empire|Corellian monarchy]] in [[312 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Corellian system became a corporatocracy. The Corellian government was fronted by a puppet ruler known as the [[Diktat]] while the state was in fact ruled by the boards of directors of powerful corporations, including CEC. The only interest of this regime was the development of economy and the growth of Corellian companies.<ref name="SoF" />

During the last decades of the Republic, prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Corellian Engineering Corporation provided the bulk of the Republic warships by producing [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]], [[Republic light assault cruiser]]s,<ref name="SOtGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> and [[CL-1c Lancet interceptor]] for the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Fleet]].<ref name="SoF" /> In [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], CEC constructed the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] YT 492727ZED, later known as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]], at [[Orbital Assembly Facility 7/Legends|Orbital Assembly Facility 7]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_the_Corridor.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A fleet of CEC-manufactured Rebel starships destroy an Imperial Star Destroyer]]
After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], CEC became a voting sponsor of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="HSCS" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Corellian Engineering Corporation was not a major supplier of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] but CEC starships were favored by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The polyvalent [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] became one of the most iconic vessels of the Rebellion.<ref name="TNEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], CEC performed [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian]],<ref name="SWG:PCMR42">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Patrol Corellian Mining Route 42|Corellian system}}</ref> [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="SWG:BSPIII" /> [[Endor system/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="SWG:BSPII" /> [[Karthakk system|Karthakk]],<ref name="SWG:E750uoOA" /> [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="SWG:E500UoOA" /> and [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]]s.<ref name="SWG:SD" /> These operations were supervised by [[Thom Steele]]<ref name="SWG:MtT">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Mission To Talus|Kashyyyk}}</ref> and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Koh (Twi'lek)|Koh]].<ref name="SWG:BtK">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|Back to Kashyyyk|Talus}}</ref> CEC mining operations were often threatened by pirates such as the [[Asteroid Bandits]].<ref name="SWG:PCMR42" />

After the Battle of Yavin, a number of CEC employees disappeared in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], on Corellia, and CEC sensitive data showed up on [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. The rival company Kuat Drive Yards was suspected to be responsible.<ref name="SoF" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Corellian Engineering Corporation frequently recruited independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to deal with minor troubles affecting the company. Such missions included the destruction of a gangster base involved in industrial espionage, the removal of dangerous wild animals from a CEC testing facility, and the elimination of a gang of criminals hired by an anti-armaments radical group to sabotage CEC weapon factories.<ref name="SWG:TFHEP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Testing Facility Has Espionage Problem}} on Corellia</ref><ref name="SWG:TFRAR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Testing Facility Requires Animal Removal}} on Corellia</ref><ref name="SWG:VPACO">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Violent Protests Against CEC Operations}} on Corellia</ref>
